about_the_game:
English Boost — Learn English without interrupting your day!
Display words over any app and learn English in the background — play games, work, watch shows, and grow your vocabulary effortlessly.

Why is English Boost exactly what you need?

🔥 Passive learning with a smart overlay
Display selected word groups in a corner of your screen — they change automatically as you go about your day. Just glance at them and memorize effortlessly while gaming, working, or watching.

🎯 Active training with flashcards
Launch training sessions, answer questions — get +1 for correct answers, −1 for mistakes. The app remembers your results and focuses more on words you struggle with.

⚙️ Flexible learning tailored to your goals
Choose from topics like travel, family, food, and more. Create your own word groups and study what matters most to you.

🧠 Smart repetition system
Words you already know disappear from training. Harder ones come back more often — for maximum retention.

📊 Clear progress tracking
See how many words you've learned in each category, track overall progress, and stay motivated.

How does it work?

  • Launch English Boost and pin a word group overlay anywhere on your screen.

  • Keep doing your usual tasks — play, work, or watch videos. Your brain catches the words passively, without effort.

  • Reinforce with flashcard training — the app tracks your answers and adjusts accordingly.

  • Harder words are shown more often.

  • Watch your progress grow.

What do you get?

✅ Real vocabulary growth without boring lessons.
✅ Learn anytime, without stopping what you're doing.
✅ Interactive control over your progress with flashcards.
✅ Total control over what and how you study.
✅ A unique tool that works silently in the background.

Who is it for?

  • For those tired of traditional courses.

  • For busy people who want to learn during everyday tasks.

  • For anyone looking for a simple, effective way to improve their vocabulary.
